## Final evidence and adoption boundaries

- User explicitly rejected every concurrency change. Root maxParallel=3, named capacities=2, mutexes, learned policy and 2000/5000 ms budgets remain unchanged. Additional action-necessity audit and fixture boundary in README-maintenance-necessity.md; all seven inputs/expected assessments remain, one real failed-command/recovery Run plus original two-Run reuse and other real integrations remain.
- Strict JSON: final independent old-source differential has 2531 inputs (448 real docs JSON), all equal. Final fixed-input byte digest 4342a9cfed7da0f1cc06bd306e0b0c4321b3f885816394b01d7702c02eb813fb. Projection removes a traversal/Set/property-definition work and file-boundary yielding is proven with queued cancellation. Final interleaved wall medians 1662.87/1653.92 ms are not a stable latency gain; do not reuse earlier ~11% as final evidence.
- Markdown cache: fixed-input digest 06bef7ba82d39096b8256507e414c8aff4c92c62343b7b15b69ce40f6dd8f1da; digest asserted unchanged at completion. Disabled/cold/warm outcomes+Records equal: 386 sources, 2273 occurrences,1873 logical target reads. Disabled median3047.11 ms, warm1521.07 ms, cold single3230.55 ms. Only warm benefit supported; cold overhead acknowledged. User-authorized local material is deletable, not a success-result cache.
- Static frontier: final N=2048 independent mutex groups median2283.85→222.31ms; independent resources8460.67→242.21ms. Shared/wide small-group shapes and N128/512/2048 retained. 2344 boundaries/2248 transitions against independent declared graph/status+original static policy; retained/captured forks, scope layers, revision and cancellation tested. Do not claim a universal Scheduler complexity bound or speedup for Gate's normal learned custom policy.
- Current target verification before the action-necessity addition:87/87 tests,722 entities/181 Cases/15 topics,product+scripts type/lint, public validate. Final expanded-source verification supersedes these where appropriate.

### Excluded/failed attempts

- Initial timer callback await mechanical edit produced one test-only property-access error; fixed to await the execution before reading result. Raw logs retained.
- Initial Gate options test wrongly expected constructor to materialize optional warnAboveBytes. Product applies16MiB at cache runtime; final test asserts Gate does not override it.4/4 target passed.
- First cache batch ran while Change prose was updated; equal facts are supporting exploratory evidence only. Final cache batch has input digest equality guard and is the adoption measurement.
- First combined full Gate was42/43: new Case prose made quality-runtime501 code lines vs existing500 allowance. Related group proofs consolidated into one coherent bullet; no proof/threshold waived. Corrected fixed-source three full Gates each43/43. Their process walls39061.99,39061.44,35991.56ms. Duration budgets remained truthful and motivated continued supporting-action audit; these runs precede the added measurement necessity slice and are not final complete-source timing.
- New helper first lint caught duplicate type import and nullable boolean condition, subsequently corrected. Do not exclude any failed behavior measurement silently or count failed lint as passed.

Raw timing is observation; operator/path proof, isolated timing and complete Gate are distinct. Existing history/caches advance normally and are not frozen or erased; unpaired whole-Gate timing cannot prove an end-to-end gain against earlier sources. Child-tree CPU is summed user+system, not wall time; maxSingleChildRssKiB is not peak summed-tree memory.

## Final action-necessity slices

- Maintenance: all seven original failure/retry inputs and independent expected counts/order/reasons remain. A raw command-result fixture moves only redundant process bootstrap out of the parser/assessment matrix; the production session defaults to real runGit, one recovery variant still runs a real transport+complete Run, and adjacent two-Run reuse/cancellation and history integrations remain. Final 10/10, product type/lint, Case/material and independent review passed. Same test file wall median4446.01→1497.31ms; child CPU5123.35→1645.61ms. README-maintenance-necessity.md retains detailed controls.
- Workbench: command execution mechanically moved to command-execution.ts and dynamically loaded only after preliminary argument/scenario-shape/registered-policy checks. Public graph and output-target rejection still belong to their original later boundaries; do not extend the lazy-load claim to every invalid input. Missing-module real bootstrap proves preliminary input rejection exit64 and accepted-input load failure contained as exit1. Original matrix/timeouts retained. Final23/23, scripts type/lint, Case722/181/15, validate and27/27Plan passed; readonly semantic/style review passed with owner wording narrowed.
